title: A job you love or a job that pays?
situation: You write a blog in English about the choices young people face after finishing school. Many of your readers have asked you the same question: "Is it better to have a well-paid job you don't enjoy or a job you love that pays less?" Write a blog post in which you discuss the question.
situationHu: Angol nyelvű blogodban arról írsz, hogy jobb-e egy jól fizető, de nem szeretett munka, vagy egy kevésbé jól fizető, de szeretett állás.

points.text: say what young people in your country consider important when choosing a career
discuss the advantages of a high salary
explain why job satisfaction might be more important in the long run
say which you would choose and why

usefulPhrases.en: What would you choose? Let me know in the comments.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ti mit választanátok? Írjátok meg kommentben!

modelAnswer.text:
Money or Passion: Which Comes First?

This week I want to answer the question so many of you have sent me: is it better to have a well-paid job you don't enjoy or a job you love that pays less?

When young people in Hungary choose a career, most of them think about money and job security first. Many of my classmates are planning to study IT or economics, not because they find these subjects exciting, but because they have heard that these jobs are well paid.

There is no denying that a high salary has clear advantages. It gives you financial security, lets you buy your own flat sooner and makes it easier to support a family. Money can't buy happiness, but it certainly makes life more comfortable.

Even so, I believe job satisfaction matters more in the long run. We spend around forty years of our lives working, and doing something you hate every day can lead to stress and burnout. My uncle left a well-paid bank job to become a carpenter, and although he earns less, he says he has never been happier.

Personally, I would rather do a job I love than earn a fortune doing something boring. I dream of becoming a biology teacher, and I am ready to live a simpler life if it means looking forward to Monday mornings.

What would you choose? Let me know in the comments!

notes: Feladat teljesítése: mind a négy szempont érdemben kifejtett – mit tartanak fontosnak a magyar fiatalok (példával az osztálytársakról), a magas fizetés három előnye, a munkával való elégedettség hosszú távú jelentősége egy személyes példával (a nagybácsi), végül egyértelmű döntés indoklással.

Szövegalkotás: a blog az olvasók kérdésére reagálva indul és kérdéssel zárul (What would you choose? Let me know in the comments!), közben a There is no denying that … / Even so, … pár kiegyensúlyozott érvelést ad.
Hangnem: félhivatalos, személyes blogstílus – néhány összevont alak (don't, can't) belefér, de a szöveg nem szlenges.
Szókincs és nyelvhelyesség: érdemes megtanulni: not because … but because …, in the long run, would rather … than …, money can't buy happiness, but …
